import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Sort by (user_id, channel, event_ts, event_id) to establish order
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        na_position="last"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    if len(events) == 0:
        return {"channel_sessions": pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
        )}

    # Detect group boundaries (new user_id/channel group) without apply
    grp_key = list(zip(events["user_id"], events["channel"]))
    is_new_group = pd.Series(
        [True] + [grp_key[i] != grp_key[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(grp_key))],
        index=events.index
    )

    # Time diff within the sorted order
    time_diffs = events["event_ts"].diff()

    gap_threshold = pd.Timedelta(minutes=25)

    # STRICT gap rule: a new session starts only if the gap is STRICTLY
    # greater than 25 minutes. A gap of exactly 25 minutes keeps the
    # session alive.
    new_session = is_new_group | time_diffs.isna() | (time_diffs > gap_threshold)

    # Session id is a global running cumsum of new_session flags
    events["_session_id"] = new_session.cumsum()

    # Aggregate to get channel_sessions per global session id
    channel_sessions = events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel", "_session_id"],
        as_index=False
    ).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count")
    )

    # Sort and renumber sessions to be 1-based per (user_id, channel)
    channel_sessions = channel_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_start"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel"]
    ).cumcount() + 1

    channel_sessions = channel_sessions[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    return {"channel_sessions": channel_sessions}
